name: Model tuning
purpose: It addresses the problem of suboptimal model performance due to non-ideal hyperparameter settings. By systematically searching for the best hyperparameters, it ensures the model generalizes well and avoids overfitting or underfitting, leading to more reliable predictions.
coreComponents: Hyperparameters (e.g., learning rate, batch size, number of layers)
Search Strategies (e.g., Grid Search, Random Search, Bayesian Optimization, Hyperband)
Evaluation Metrics (e.g., accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score)
integrations: TensorFlow/Keras (TensorFlow Model Optimization Toolkit, Keras Tuner)
useCases: Optimizing deep learning models for image classification
Fine-tuning NLP models for sentiment analysis or content generation
Improving predictive accuracy in financial forecasting
Deploying models on edge devices with resource constraints
